coral

(noun). san hô

ex: They contain corals, but are not coral reefs.

reef

(noun). đá ngầm

ex: it's a dangerous offshore reef

glean

(verb). Obtain information

ex: From what I was able to glean, the news isn't good.

shallow

(adjective). Nông cạn

ex: She told her children to stay in the shallow end (of the swimming pool).

lagoon

(noun). đầm phá

ex: This lagoon forms a commodious harbour, once the bar has been crossed

accessible

(adjective). Có thể tiếp cận, truy cập được

ex: The resort is easily accessible by road, rail, and air.

engage

(verb). bắt giữ

ex: I have engaged a secretary to deal with all my paperwork.

manual

(adjective). Làm thủ công, làm bằng tay

ex: He still works on an old manual typewriter.

harvest

(noun). thu hoạch

ex: We had a good harvest this year.

Involvement

(noun). Sự tham gia

ex: Being on the committee is one involvement I could do without.

occupation

(noun). Nghề nghiệp

ex: In the space marked "occupation" she wrote "police officer".

status

(noun). Địa vị

ex: There has been an increase in applications for refugee status.

fishery

(noun). vùng đánh cá, ngư trường

ex: The depletion of fisheries has serious impacts on food security.

physical

(adjective). Thuộc về mặt vật lý, cơ thể

ex: she does a lot of physical activity

accessibility

(noun). khả năng tiếp cận

ex: The theater offers full wheelchair accessibility.

direct

(adjective). Trực diện

ex: Is there a direct train to Edinburgh?

consequently

(adverb). kết quả là

ex: All the shops were closed, and consequently we couldn't buy any food.

independence

(noun). Sự độc lập

ex: Mexico gained its independence from Spain in 1821.

valuable

(adjective). đáng giá

ex: These antiques are extremely valuable.

acquire

(verb). Thu mua

ex: He acquired the firm in 2008.

western

(adjective). miền Tây

Pacific

(adjective). Thái Bình Dương

right

ex: She was too elderly and infirm to remain at home.

underpin

(verb). chống bằng trụ, nâng đỡ

ex: He presented data to underpin his argument.

reliant

(adjective). phụ thuộc

ex: He's completely reliant on his wheelchair to get about.

sections.title: Passage 2: Acquiring the principles of mathematics and science
sections.html:
concept

(noun). Khái niệm, ý tưởng

ex: The concept of free speech is unknown to them.

distinction

(noun). Sự phân biệt rạch ròi

ex: This company makes no distinction between the sexes.

conceptual

(adjective). lý thuyết

ex: The introduction lays out a conceptual framework for the book.

superficial

(adjective). ngoại thất

ex: the building suffered only superficial damage

formula

(noun). công thức

ex: There's no magic formula for success.

terminology

(noun). Thuật ngữ

ex: Page 63 speaks about the goal given in the head: that is not the correct terminology.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

ex: it's a beautifully illustrated book/old manuscript

claim

(verb). đòi quyền

ex: When my bike was stolen, I claimed on the insurance and got £150 back.

contradiction

(noun). Sự mâu thuẫn

ex: Many people think that an honest politician is a contradiction in terms.

assist

(verb). Hỗ trợ

ex: The army arrived to assist in the search.

mental

(adjective). Liên quan đến thần kinh

ex: The family has a history of mental disorder.

psychologist

(noun). Nhà tâm lý học

ex: She spent 15 years as a clinical psychologist.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

ex: Several hypotheses for global warming have been suggested.

cognitive

(adjective). Liên quan đến nhận thức

ex: Some of her cognitive functions have been impaired.

intellectual

(adjective). Về mặt trí tuệ

ex: I like detective stories and romances - nothing too intellectual.

confront

(verb). đối mặt

ex: She was confronted by a man wielding a knife.

disequilibrium

(noun). sự mất cân bằng

ex: It is important to regulate disequilibrium in order to minimize its impact on the corporate marketplace.

equilibration

(noun). sự làm cân bằng

ex: cognitive development involves an ongoing attempt to achieve a balance between assimilation and accommodation that he termed equilibration.

actively

(adverb). tích cực

ex: He's very actively involved in (= does a lot of work for) the local party.

engage

(verb). bắt giữ

ex: I have engaged a secretary to deal with all my paperwork.

discard

(verb). Vứt bỏ

ex: Discarded food containers and bottles littered the streets.

contradictory

(adjective). mâu thuẫn

ex: The findings of these studies have been contradictory

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

ex: The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; Học thuyết

ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

modification

(noun). sự thay đổi

ex: A couple of modifications and the speech will be perfect.

approach

(verb). Tiếp cận

ex: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.

Tone

(noun). tiếng, thanh âm

ex: I tried to use a sympathetic tone of voice.

route

(noun). Tuyến đường

ex: The route we had planned took us right across Greece.

peer

(noun). bạn cùng tuổi

ex: Do you think it's true that teenage girls are less self-confident than their male peers?

subsequently

(adverb). sau đó

ex: He was badly injured in the crash and subsequently died.

propose

(verb). đề nghị

ex: He proposed dealing directly with the suppliers.

interpersonal

(adjective). giữa cá nhân với nhau

ex: The successful applicant will have excellent interpersonal skills.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột

ex: There was a lot of conflict between him and his father.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

ex: Scotland Yard have been called in to investigate the murder.

rejection

(noun). sự bác bỏ

ex: The government's rejection of the plans is a setback for us.

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

ex: We're entertaining some colleagues of Carol's tonight.

relevant

(adjective). Có liên quan

ex: Education should be relevant to the child's needs.

progress

(noun). tiến triển

ex: Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.

influence

(noun). Sức ảnh hưởng

ex: Helen's a bad/good influence on him.

motion

(noun). Chuyển động

ex: The violent motion of the ship upset his stomach.

slope

(noun). dốc

ex: The roof is at a slope (= at an angle to a horizontal surface) of 30°.

ascertain

(verb). Làm chắc chắn

ex: Have you ascertained whether she's coming or not?

dissimilar

(adjective). khác biệt

ex: The new house is not dissimilar (= is similar) to our old one, except that it's slightly bigger.

session

(noun). phiên họp

ex: The parliamentary session is due to end on 27 May.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm

ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

partner

(noun). đối tác

ex: He gave up his job as a police officer after his partner was killed.

function

(noun). Chức năng

ex: I'm not quite sure what my function is within the company.

initial

(adjective). ban đầu

ex: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.

attribute

(noun). Thuộc tính

ex: Self-confidence is a rare attribute in a 17-year-old.

passage

(noun). đoạn văn

ex: he picked up the newspaper and read the passage again

stimulus

(noun). kích thích

ex: Foreign investment has been a stimulus to the industry.

Repetition

(noun). sự lặp lại

ex: His books are full of repetition.

consistency

(noun). tính nhất quán

ex: Melt the chocolate to a pouring (= easy to pour) consistency.

input

(noun). Đầu vào

ex: The power input will come largely from hydroelectricity.

aid

(verb). viện trợ

ex: His excuse for drinking brandy is that it's said to aid digestion.

preconception

(noun). định kiến

ex: Many people still have preconceptions about how Native Americans live.

scientific

(adjective). mang tính khoa học

ex: The project has attracted considerable criticism from the scientific community

talkative

(adjective). hay nói, ba hoa

ex: She's a lively, talkative person.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

ex: we have encountered one small problem

correspond

(verb). đối nhau

ex: The American FBI corresponds to the British MI5.

application

(noun). Đơn xin việc

ex: I've sent off applications for four different jobs.

pupil

(noun). Học sinh

ex: The school has over 400 pupils.

interaction

(noun). Sự tương tác

ex: The play follows the interactions of three very different characters.

hypothesize

(verb). giả thiết hóa

ex: This discovery led experts to hypothesize a different path of evolution for early man.

sections.title: Passage 3: Learning lessons from the past
sections.html:
monumental

(adjective). to lớn

ex: it's been a monumental effort

ruin

(noun). đổ nát

ex: the church is a ruin now

income

(noun). Thu nhập

ex: Average incomes have risen by 4.5 percent over the past year.

generate

(verb). Tạo ra

ex: The new development will generate 1,500 new jobs.

tourism

(noun). Ngành du lịch

ex: Tourism is Venice's main industry.

occupy

(verb). Chiếm vị trí

ex: The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.

archaeological

(adjective). thuộc khảo cổ

ex: An Austrian Archaeological Institute was founded in 1898

appeal

(noun). lời khẩn cầu

ex: They're launching an appeal to raise money for famine victims.

romantic

(adjective). lãng mạn

ex: You used to be so romantic, but now you never tell me that you love me.

collapse

(verb). sụp đổ

ex: The chair collapsed under her weight.

vanish

(verb). Biến mất

ex: The child vanished while on her way home from school.

sonnet

(noun). Bài thơ mười bốn câu

ex: the city he conjures up in that sonnet is sleeping and silent

drastic

(adjective). mạnh mẽ, quyết liệt

ex: Many employees have had to take drastic cuts in pay.

complexity

(noun). Độ tinh xảo, phức tạp

ex: There are a lot of complexities surrounding this issue.

considerable

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý

ex: The fire caused considerable damage to the church.

extend

(verb). Mở rộng

ex: We have plans to extend our house (= to make it bigger).

mystery

(noun). điều kì bí

ex: The mystery was solved when the police discovered the murder weapon.

testify

(verb). làm bằng chứng cho

ex: They were subpoenaed to testify before the judge.

finding

(noun). Phát hiện, thông tin tìm được

ex: These new findings turn the accepted theories on their head.

civilisation

(noun). Nền văn minh

ex: Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.

overturn

(verb). Làm cho lật ngửa

ex: The car skidded off the road, hit a tree and overturned.

controversy

(noun). tranh cãi

ex: The policy has caused fierce/heated controversy ever since it was introduced.

amongst

(preposition). amongst

ex: Relax, you're amongst friends.

scientist

(noun). nhà khoa học

ex: There are scientists who say that the results of the research are flawed.

discipline

(noun). Kỉ luật

ex: I don't have enough (self) discipline to save money.

cause

(noun). nguyên nhân

ex: The police are still trying to establish the cause of the fire.

suspicion

(noun). sự nghi ngờ

ex: We always had the suspicion that their marriage was not happy.

ecological

(adjective). Liên quan đến hệ sinh thái

ex: The destruction of the rain forests is an ecological disaster.

suicide

(noun). vụ tự sát

ex: She attempted suicide when she was a teenager.

ecocide

(noun). Thuốc hủy diệt sinh thái

ex: We all know that carbon emissions are contributing to global warming and ecocide.

archaeologist

(noun). nhà khảo cổ học

ex: She wanted to be an archaeologist and took part in several digs in her youth.

climatologist

(noun). Nhà khí tượng học

ex If the climatologists are right, then we are falling well short of the requirements which have to be met.

historian

(noun). Sử gia

ex: Her father was an eminent historian.

palaeontologist

(noun). Nhà cổ sinh vật học

ex: Palaeontologists can now look inside fossils without damaging them.

pollen

(noun). Phấn hoa

ex: Bees pollinate the plants by carrying the pollen from one flower to another.

pace

(noun). nhịp, bước

ex: I can't keep pace with (= walk or run as fast as) you.

likelihood

(noun). khả năng xảy ra

ex: There is little likelihood now that interest rates will come down further.

foreseeable

(adjective). có thể nhìn thấy trước

ex: I'll be living here for the foreseeable future.

Deterioration

(noun). sự hư hỏng, xấu đi

ex: When we arrived, we were appalled at her deterioration.

invariably

(adverb). trong từng trường hợp

ex: The train is invariably late.

citizen

(noun). Công dân

ex: Old people are just treated like second-class citizens (= unimportant people).

trajectory

(noun). quỹ đạo

ex: The missile came in on a very low trajectory.

unvaryingly

(adverb). không chê vào đâu được

ex: your pace is unvaryingly good

represent

(verb). đại diện

ex: Union officials representing the teachers met the government today.

overshadow

(verb). che bóng

ex: My happiness was overshadowed by the bad news.

accumulation

(noun). tích lũy

ex: Despite this accumulation of evidence, the government persisted in doing nothing.

poisonous

(adjective). Có chứa độc tố

ex: Can you tell the difference between poisonous mushrooms and edible varieties?

substance

(noun). Vật chất

ex: What sort of substance could withstand those temperatures?

toxic

(adjective). Độc hại

ex: The seeds contain a toxic substance, which makes them actively poisonous

chemical

(noun). hoá chất

ex: They use special chemicals to accelerate the growth of crops.

seriousness

(noun). sự nghiêm trọng

ex: I don't think he has any idea of the seriousness of the situation.

vigorously

(adverb). mạnh bạo, dữ dội

ex: He vigorously denied the accusations.

debate

(verb). tranh luận

ex: the board debated his proposal

resemble

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

ex: You resemble your mother very closely.

practical

(adjective). Thực tiễn

ex: So how does this theory translate into practical policy?

appliable

(adjective). có thể trang bị

ex: This rule is not appliable to young persons

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

ex: Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?

comparison

(noun). sự so sánh

ex: They made a comparison of different countries' eating habits.

naive

(adjective). ngây thơ

ex: She was very naive to believe that he'd stay with her.

yield

(verb). sản xuất ra

ex: it was an attempt to yield increased profits

transferable

(adjective). có thể chuyên nhượng

ex: The tickets were marked "not transferable".

wealth

(noun). Sự giàu có.

ex: During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.

valid

(adjective). Hợp lệ

ex: Is this contract/ticket/agreement still valid?

parallel

(noun). tương đồng, tương tự

ex: I'm trying to see if there are any obvious parallels between the two cases.

tempting

(adjective). hấp dẫn

ex: That pie looks very tempting.

analogy

(noun). Phép so sánh

ex: he interprets logical functions by analogy with machines

peak

(noun). đỉnh

ex: anyone who saw Jones at his peak looked upon genius

metaphor

(noun). Phép ẩn dụ

ex: her poetry depends on suggestion and metaphor

erroneous

(adjective). sai, sai lầm

ex: employers sometimes make erroneous assumptions

undermine

(verb). phá hoại

ex: this could undermine years of hard work

climate

(noun). Khí hậu

ex: When we retire, we're going to move to a warmer climate.

shortage

(noun). sự thiếu

ex: There's a shortage of food and shelter in the refugee camps.

utilization

(noun). tận dụng

ex: Sensible utilization of the world's resources is a priority.

photosynthetic

(noun). quang hợp

ex: To this end the photosynthetic pathways have been studied in detail.

capacity

(noun). sức chứa

ex: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000.

potentially

(adverb). Có triển vọng

ex: Hepatitis is a potentially fatal disease.

respect

(noun). sự tôn trọng

ex: I have great/the greatest respect for his ideas, although I don't agree with them.

beneficial

(adjective). Có lợi

ex: A stay in the country will be beneficial to his health.

globalization

(noun). toàn cầu hóa

ex: the globalization of fashion/American youth culture is fast

distant

(adjective). xa

ex: She could hear the distant sound of fireworks exploding.

potent

(adjective). tiềm năng

ex: Surprise remains the terrorists' most potent weapon.

destructive

(adjective). tình trạng

ex: Lack of trust is very destructive in a relationship.

historical

(adjective). Mang tính lịch sử

ex: The table compares historical exchange rates for five different currencies.

trend

(noun). Xu hướng

ex: There's been a downward/upward trend in sales in the last few years.

argument

(noun). Cuộc tranh luận

ex: The children had an argument about/over what game to play.

remains

(noun). còn lại

ex: The remains of lunch were still on the table.

survival

(noun). sự sinh tồn

ex: His main concern is to ensure his own political survival.

fascination

(noun). Sự mê hoặc

ex: Mass murders hold a gruesome fascination for the public.

mighty

(adjective). hùng mạnh

ex: In the next game they will face the mighty Patriots.

abandonment

(noun). sự bỏ rơi

ex: The abandonment of the island followed nuclear tests in the area.

similarity

(noun). sự giống nhau

ex: I can see the similarity between you and your mother.

fledge

(verb). nuôi cho đủ lông đủ cánh để bay

ex: The chicks are expected to fledge in August.

boundary

(noun). Ranh giới

ex: The Ural mountains mark the boundary between Europe and Asia.

Valley

(noun). Thung lũng

ex: There was snow on the hill tops but not in the valley.

marvel

(verb). Trầm trồ ngạc nhiên

ex: We paused to marvel at the view.

inadvertently

(adverb). một cách vô ý

ex: He inadvertently deleted the file.

category

(noun). Phân loại

ex: There are three categories of accommodation - standard, executive, and deluxe.

deforestation

(noun). sự phá rừng

ex: Deforestation is destroying large areas of tropical rain forest.

habitat

(noun). Môi trường sống

ex: With so many areas of woodland being cut down, a lot of wildlife is losing its natural habitat.

native

(adjective). bản địa, địa phương

ex: She returned to live and work in her native Japan.

introduced species

(noun). Loài du nhập

ex: Many introduced species appear to lack most or all of their native, presumably coevolved, natural enemies.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

ex: The disks and granules constitute a very powerful microphone.

variation

(noun). biến thể

ex: The medical tests showed some variation in the baby's heart rate.

exaggerate

(verb). Phóng đại

ex: The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.

conversely

(adverb). Ngược lại mà nói

ex: Conversely, the master acknowledges the rights of disciples to take their own students.

substitute

(noun). vật thay thế

ex: the center's work was to be seen as supplementary to orthodox treatment and not a substitute for it

manageable

(adjective). có thê quản lý, điều hành

ex: The work has been divided into smaller, more manageable sections.
